§6Hard Plastic§f

§aPost-bismuth polycarbonate  -  the material behind catalytic reformers, missiles, and advanced circuits!§f

Hard Plastic is made by combining §bBTX§f and §bPhosgene§f in the §bChemical Plant§f. Recipe: §e500mB§f BTX + §e500mB§f Phosgene yields §e1×§f Hard Plastic Bar. Needs the Polycarbonate Synthesis template.

§6What it builds§f:
§b•§f Catalytic Reformer components  -  gates the entire advanced refining chain.
§b•§f Versatile Circuit Boards and other high-tier circuits.
§b•§f Missile body and warhead recipes.
§b•§f Various late-game HBM machines.

§6Prerequisites§f:
§b•§f BTX production requires bismuth in the chain.
§b•§f Phosgene requires chlorine.

§ePS:§f Hard Plastic is a significant milestone. Once you can produce it, the Catalytic Reformer and all its advanced chains open up. Get your bismuth and chlorine supply sorted first!
